about: The offertorium of the formulary “Third Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: The right hand of the Lord hath wrought strength; the right hand of the Lord hath exalted me. I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the Lord.

w014.gloss: tell, tell about, relate, narrate, recount, describe
